from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyWorkingCapitalData(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial data for a single company to evaluate working capital risk conditions."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company as reported in the document")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock code of the company, if available")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period, e.g., '2025 First Quarter'")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency of the financial figures, e.g., 'CNY'")
    
    # Condition 1 & 2 Inputs
    net_profit_attributable_to_shareholders: float | None = Field(description="Net Profit Attributable to Shareholders")
    net_cash_flow_from_operating_activities: float | None = Field(description="Net Cash Flow from Operating Activities")
    
    # Condition 3 Inputs: Working Capital Intensity = (Accounts Receivable + Inventory) / Operating Revenue
    operating_revenue: float | None = Field(description="Operating Revenue")
    accounts_receivable: float | None = Field(description="Accounts Receivable")
    inventory: float | None = Field(description="Inventory")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[CompanyWorkingCapitalData]
